scope: Production Kotlin GameEventStore on JVM, Android source wiring, real installer templates and existing Cards registry regression. Not a full Android host compilation or device run.
command: LUMO_KOTLIN_LIB_DIR=<verified-gradle-9.1.0>/lib PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_game_return_contract scripts.tests.test_embedded_android scripts.tests.test_prepare_android scripts.tests.test_cards_authority_registry -v

transport.scope: Private MainActivity-generated UUID for validated learning/cards launches only; native verifies scene and launch session match.
transport.durable_event: results unchanged; destination remains persisted with callerReturnSession until exact live completion or cold-host acknowledgement.
transport.warm_pending: Suppress destination and session only when stored session equals the live pending MethodChannel caller.
transport.completion: After existing process-stop wait; require same live callback/session and non-destroyed Activity. Atomically remove only equal destination+session before callback success and unlocking.
transport.storage_exception: AtomicFile failure keeps durable fallback/rewards and live caller; completion retries after one second until committed or Activity destroyed.
transport.cold_fallback: Recreated MainActivity has no live caller; normal learn/games destination remains visible and acknowledgeable.
transport.stale_ack: An old same-destination generic ACK cannot remove a caller-tagged return while a caller is live; requested reward IDs alone are acknowledged.
transport.stale_launch: A newly validated explicit caller launch supersedes only prior navigation keys, preserving all rewards.
transport.legacy: 2017 raw events and all legacy game returns remain ordinary destination navigation.

compiler.kind: Kotlin JVM compiler from verified Gradle9.1.0 distribution

limits: The Android adapters are test-only and do not emulate Android lifecycle or AtomicFile internals.
The full Android Kotlin/Java host and APK must be compiled and rerun in the real emulator pipeline.
Flutter AppShell/Guided/Cards lifecycle regression and original RED evidence are maintained separately by Team A.
No Dart production changes, no Godot source changes, no new version or release claim.
